content: If the Time Master transmits a Follow_Up message (refer to [PRS_TS_00018] in [1]), the following sequence shall be applied: 23 of 87 Document ID 676: AUTOSAR_SWS_TimeSyncOverEthernet Specification of Time Synchronization over Ethernet AUTOSAR CP R21-11 • Get a free transmission buffer via EthIf_Provide_TxBuffer • Trigger transmit request with the transmission timestamp of [SWS_ EthT- Syn _00017] via EthIf_Transmit
